text:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: PagerDuty Alert — cache-main write latency spike + PG conn pressure. Page fired to DB-Oncall (db-oncall@pagerduty). Alert links: https://pagerduty.example/incidents/INC12345

pagerduty-bot: Escalation scheduled: db-oncall -> senior-db in 3m if not acknowledged.

david-oncall: ack — I'm looking. spinning up terminal.

carla-db: I'm awake, joining. any sample errors from the app?

david-oncall: paste logs:
```
2026-03-14T19:27:03Z app[web.3]: ERROR cache: write timeout (redis://cache-main:6379) key=user:batch:12345
2026-03-14T19:27:04Z app[web.2]: WARN pg: connection timeout after 500ms
2026-03-14T19:27:05Z app[worker.7]: ERROR bulk-sync: failed step write-cache: timeout
```

alice-sre: grafana shows redis `cmdstat.set` p95 ~1.2s, p99 ~2.8s. Redis host iowait jumped. PG active connections at 480/500 (pool 500), connection queueing.

ben-platform: k8s: cronjob `bulk-sync-prod` started at 19:28 UTC. It spawned ~120 short-lived workers hitting cache+db. pod names `bulk-sync-xxxxx` in ns=prod. Suggest scale job to 0 to stop new workers.

david-oncall: applying immediate mitigation: scaling job down + pausing producers.
```
kubectl -n prod scale job bulk-sync-prod --replicas=0
# blocking feature flag
curl -XPOST "https://flags.internal/api/flags/bulk_sync" -d '{"enabled":false}' -H "Authorization: Bearer $FF_TOKEN"
```

carla-db: checking redis:
```
redis-cli -h cache-main INFO persistence
# returns: bgsave_in_progress:1
# rdb_bgsave_time_sec: 58
# rdb_changes_since_last_save: 4,200,345
```
slowlog head:
```
1) 10000 | 1641234567 | "SET" "user:..." "..." (microseconds)
2) 9800  | 1641234566 | "HMSET" ...
```
CONFIG GET stop-writes-on-bgsave-error -> "yes"
```

carla-db: looks like BGSAVE is taking long due to huge dataset and blocking writes under pressure -> writes waiting on disk/persistence and clients piling up.

alice-sre: is this a persistent replica or primary? Host `cache-main-1` is primary, yes.

david-oncall: given severity I'll keep job paused. monitoring now.

--- 5m later ---

david-oncall: after scaling job down + flipping flag: redis set latency p95 down to 90ms, app errors dropped from ~12% to 0.8%, PG active connections fell to 140. Good.

carla-db: we should avoid setting `stop-writes-on-bgsave-error no` unless we know FS is reliable. Short-term options: move RDB frequency, use AOF appendfsync less aggressive, or offload snapshot to replica.

ben-platform: opening PR to rate-limit bulk-sync workers + add small jitter and exponential backoff. Also proposing a circuit-breaker in app on cache write failures.

eve-customer-success: any customer-facing impact? We saw a 10 min window with errors affecting some batch sync jobs. CS will notify top 3 enterprise customers with the summary and mitigation.

david-oncall: notes for post-incident: 1) root cause = concurrent heavy bulk job triggered during RDB snapshot causing Redis write latency spike -> backpressure to app -> increased PG connections; 2) mitigation = paused job + feature flag; 3) follow-ups = adjust persistence config, add rate-limiting, add alert on BGSAVE duration and slowlog growth, consider offloading bulk-sync or using background queuing system.

pagerduty-bot: Acknowledged by david-oncall. Incident severity lowered. Escalation cancelled.

carla-db: I'll file a DB incident ticket (DB-INC-2026-03-14) with timeline, slowlog, and recommended persistence tuning.

alice-sre: handoff: david, I'm taking next 4h watch for follow-up. please drop any remaining notes.

david-oncall: handoff ack. brief: job paused at 19:30 UTC; metrics returned to baseline by 19:36 UTC. follow-ups assigned to carla-db and ben-platform.

incident-bot: incident thread closed — resolve if no further activity.
